definitions.name: any_delay_positive
definitions.description: Late when actual delivery is more than 0 minutes after promised ETA; denominator is delivered rows with both timestamps present.

definitions.name: delay_over_10_minutes
definitions.description: Late when actual delivery is more than 10 minutes after promised ETA; denominator is delivered rows with both timestamps present.

definitions.name: historical_delivered_non_null
definitions.description: Historical-style calculation using delivered rows with non-null promised ETA and actual delivery timestamps; late means positive delay.

ownership: The KPI/business owner must approve the published definition and denominator before leadership reporting.
